FULLBORG.Title: Go Metal
FULLBORG.NoPack: The Full Borg bodies compendium isn't available. Check that Neon Hub: Full Borg is enabled.

HL.Title: Humanity Loss (the whole package)
HL.staticHint: FBC Baselines let you take the average when chrome goes into an FBC: {static}.
HL.noneHint: No Humanity Loss, for a body the table has already paid for.

FULLBORG.HasBiosystem: Their brain is already in a Biosystem.
FULLBORG.AddBiosystem: Install a Biosystem too (10,000eb, HL 14 (4d6), Borgware)
FULLBORG.StripOld: Uninstall the old body's chrome (it stays on the sheet, uninstalled). The Biosystem stays.
FULLBORG.SwitchHint: Switching bodies: all chrome in the old body comes out with it. Chrome you added to the old body stays on the sheet, uninstalled.
FULLBORG.Rules: Each body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Internal and External Body slots are doubled. Full Body Conversion rules: Core Rules (2070), Chapter 09.
FULLBORG.Confirm: Install the {body} on {name}? Their brain goes into a Biosystem for good.
FULLBORG.ConfirmSwitch: Move {name} from their current body into the {body}? (DV17 Cybertech or Surgery, 4 hours, retry freely.)
FULLBORG.ConfirmLeave: Take {name} out of the {body}? The body's chrome comes off the sheet; the Biosystem stays. Outside a body they can only watch and talk.
FULLBORG.AskGM: {body} is on your sheet. Ask the GM to install it with Go Metal.

Chat.LeftHint: Just a Biosystem now: it can watch and talk, and it's cover with 25 HP.
Chat.Body: Frame {frame}: BODY {body}, which sets HP and Death Save.
Chat.OldChrome: The old body's chrome was uninstalled and stays on the sheet.

Error.GMOnly: Only the GM can install a Full Body Conversion.
Error.NoBody: That body isn't in the Full Borg bodies compendium.
Error.NoHub: Neon Hub: Full Borg needs Neon Hub enabled for its look.
